summary: To use a collection in controller projects, add it to a custom execution environment: start from a base EE, add the collections, build, verify, tag and push to private automation hub, pull it into automation controller, and call the roles by their fully qualified names.
questions: How do I use my custom collection in automation controller jobs?
Do I need to build an execution environment to use my roles collection?
How do I add a collection to an execution environment?
